slices.focus: Saira writes a blunt memo to Peter arguing against a rushed sale, using workflow evidence
slices.summary: Peter quietly sounds out retirement timing amid outside interest in local pharmacies. Saira writes a direct memo using two years of queue data, error reduction, and patient comments to argue the pharmacy has a realistic fighting chance to remain independent. Peter engages with practical questions rather than defensiveness.
